name: Lesson 1 · Paddle, stand, pump
intro: Welcome to the line-up. Paddle into the wave, stand up, and find speed.

goals.hint: Both sticks down to press your feet, then flick both up to pop to your feet as the wave lifts you
goals.hintClassic: Paddle along the wave with ← → (stick), then press L or Y to stand as it lifts you

goals.hint: Speed is a rhythm: extend (sticks up) as you climb, compress (sticks down) as you drop. Holding a stick does nothing
goals.hintClassic: Hold ↑ (stick up) to pump. Pumping while dropping down the face gives the most speed

goals.label: Ride 20 s without wiping out
goals.hint: Lean both sticks together to steer. Press the front foot (right stick down) to drive down the line
goals.hintClassic: Trim mid-face with a neutral stick. Stalling (↓) lets the whitewater catch you
